reasoningChain.evidence: I want to prepare and learn the newly rescued ranger before continuing the main route.
The ranger was rescued as a sustained single-target hero, and a saved weapon was clearly meant for this hero.
The rare shield-breaking bow lists the ranger as its best fit and adds mark strength.
The ranger's weapon slot is empty, so the bow can be equipped without replacing anything.
Equipping the purpose-matched bow preserves the rescued hero's visible specialty better than giving it to a generic fighter.
